scope: Selected starting guides with actual content reviews, not exhaustive histories. Publication/source/image quantities are separate from completion.

profiles.name: Ho-Chunk
researchGaps: Add independently scoped Winnebago Tribe of Nebraska history and other Ho-Chunk community accounts.
Inspect further community-authored history, language publications and original records beyond the selected institutional passages.
Government names, historical people names and older uses of Winnebago require context; this guide does not settle every historical label.

profiles.name: Kalispel
researchGaps: Review Upper and Lower Kalispel histories through further community-directed sources, not only a regional compilation.
Inspect original removal, reservation and land records; current boundaries, legal status and population are not determined here.
Add fuller language, family and contemporary cultural accounts with appropriate public scope.

profiles.name: Mohican
researchGaps: Deepen community-authored Mohican history before and beyond the selected migration narrative.
Compare original records and additional Munsee accounts; a combined government does not make all related peoples interchangeable.
Follow later public-history projects through community evaluations and dated access information.

profiles.name: Algonquin
researchGaps: Add other Algonquin First Nations’ own histories and educational work; this starting path intentionally covers only one community example.
Inspect the original Algonquin Nation Secretariat material-culture and place-name leads before using their claims.
The term Algonquin and the wider linguistic label Algonquian have different scopes; detailed naming history needs fuller source review.

Expand language, family, education and livelihoods histories; no speaker or population total is asserted.

sourceCounting: 39added profile-source contexts and one intentionally upgraded old Kalispel card; repeated URLs/previous reviews are not globally new works. Identity-only outline evidence does not count.
mediaAccess: Original media rate-limits were respected; exact provider-listed lower-load previews or independently linked Flickr original retrieved normally. Each record states actual inspected frame/size; no blocked challenge was bypassed.
provenance: Credits, rights and source/preview limits appear in the shared image registry. No private files or full third-party source texts are published.
